# AIS Frozen Food

> Toko frozen food di Margorejo, Pati, Jawa Tengah — 08.00–20.00 WIB setiap hari. Menyediakan dimsum, singkong keju, pisang coklat lumer, cilok & cireng, saus mentai, sushi nori, rice paper. Layanan ambil di toko, pesan antar Pati–Kudus, reseller & grosir via WhatsApp 0852-2612-2121.

## Ringkasan
- [Beranda — AIS Frozen Food](https://www.ais-frozen-food.web.id): Katalog frozen food lokal untuk rumah, warung, reseller, dan grosir — pesan via WhatsApp, ambil di toko atau pesan antar Pati–Kudus.

## Produk — 5 kategori, 8 poster, 15 varian
- [Dimsum Ayam Ori — 35000 IDR](https://www.ais-frozen-food.web.id/#produk): Isi 10 + saus, klasik gurih — poster Dimsum Klasik.
- [Dimsum Ayam Keju — 38000 IDR](https://www.ais-frozen-food.web.id/#produk): Isian keju lumer.
- [Dimsum Udang — 40000 IDR](https://www.ais-frozen-food.web.id/#produk): Udang segar premium — poster Dimsum Spesial.
- [Dimsum Ayam Pedas — 38000 IDR](https://www.ais-frozen-food.web.id/#produk): Varian pedas.
- [Singkong Keju — 28000 IDR](https://www.ais-frozen-food.web.id/#produk): Renyah tabur keju — poster Aneka Siap Goreng.
- [Gemblong Cotot — 26000 IDR](https://www.ais-frozen-food.web.id/#produk): Khas Salatiga, frozen tanpa pengawet.
- [Timusku — 27000 IDR](https://www.ais-frozen-food.web.id/#produk): Camilan gurih renyah.
- [Pisang Coklat — 32000 IDR](https://www.ais-frozen-food.web.id/#produk): Lumer/keju/oreo/milo — poster Pisang & Nangka Coklat.
- [Nangka Coklat — 30000 IDR](https://www.ais-frozen-food.web.id/#produk): Balut coklat lumer.
- [Cimol / Cilok Bean — 25000 IDR](https://www.ais-frozen-food.web.id/#produk): Kopong/keju/bumbu kacang — poster Cilok & Cireng.
- [Cireng Kriwil Bean — 26000 IDR](https://www.ais-frozen-food.web.id/#produk): Original/sambal rujak.
- [Sushi Nori — 38000 IDR](https://www.ais-frozen-food.web.id/#produk): Roasted seaweed halal.
- [Rice Paper — 30000 IDR](https://www.ais-frozen-food.web.id/#produk): Kulit lumpia 10 lembar.
- [Saus Mentai — 55000 IDR](https://www.ais-frozen-food.web.id/#produk): 250gr/500gr/1kg — pedas gurih.
- [Poster — Dimsum Klasik](https://www.ais-frozen-food.web.id/#produk): Ayam Ori/Keju/Jamur/Kepiting — 35000–40000 IDR.
- [Poster — Dimsum Spesial](https://www.ais-frozen-food.web.id/#produk): Udang/Ayam Pedas/Cumi/Roll Tuna/Ekado — 38000–45000 IDR.

## Layanan & Logistik
- [Ambil di toko — Margorejo, Pati](https://www.google.com/maps/place/AIS+FROZEN+FOOD/@-6.7850225,110.9860776,17z): Lumpur, Bumirejo, Kec. Margorejo, Kab. Pati — stok harian tersedia.
- [Pesan antar — Pati–Kudus](https://www.ais-frozen-food.web.id/#kontak): Ongkir 10000 IDR, handling 0–1 hari + transit 1–2 hari, via WhatsApp.
- [Reseller & Grosir](https://wa.me/6285226122121): Harga khusus jumlah banyak — hubungi WhatsApp untuk price list grosir.
- [Pembayaran — Cash/QRIS/Transfer](https://www.ais-frozen-food.web.id): IDR, Return 7 hari via pos (biaya pembeli).
